title: [Audit] 🗂️ Kibana Object Forensics
description: Every Kibana saved-object read and change, by type, name, space and actor.

config.description: All Kibana audit events. Usually a small fraction of raw stream volume, but most of the forensic value — this is where saved objects, spaces and sessions are recorded.

data_source.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE resource.attributes.service.name == "serverless-kibana" | STATS `Kibana events` = COUNT(*)

config.description: Every Kibana state change in range, selected by ECS event.type rather than by an action-name suffix. That matters: a suffix test cannot see rule_enable, rule_disable, the whole case_user_action family, or anything the workflow, ML and agent-builder features emit, because none of those action names end in _create/_update/_delete. Point-in-time open/close are ECS-tagged creation/deletion but are query internals, and are excluded by name.

data_source.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE (resource.attributes.service.name == "serverless-kibana" AND ((attributes.event.type IN ("change","creation","deletion") AND (attributes.event.action IS NULL OR NOT (attributes.event.action IN ("saved_object_open_point_in_time","saved_object_close_point_in_time")))) OR attributes.event.action IN ("rule_run_soon","secret_create"))) | STATS `Mutations` = COUNT(*)

config.description: Distinct Kibana objects accessed or modified in range — reads included, as the name says. Identity is attributes.kibana.saved_object.id where Kibana records one and is recovered from body.text otherwise, because workflows, ML jobs and agent-builder tools carry no saved_object fields at all.

data_source.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE resource.attributes.service.name == "serverless-kibana" | GROK body.text """\[(?:id|workflowId)=%{DATA:g_id}(?:,|\])""" | EVAL obj_id = COALESCE(attributes.kibana.saved_object.id, g_id) | STATS `Objects touched` = COUNT_DISTINCT(obj_id)

config.description: How many different kinds of thing were involved (dashboard, alert, index-pattern, tag, workflow …). Restricted to events that actually name an object: without that guard the derived type falls back to the action name and http_request — logged for every Kibana request — would count as an object type.

data_source.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE resource.attributes.service.name == "serverless-kibana" | GROK body.text """\[(?:id|workflowId)=%{DATA:g_id}(?:,|\])""" | EVAL obj_id = COALESCE(attributes.kibana.saved_object.id, g_id) | EVAL obj_type = CASE(attributes.kibana.saved_object.type IS NOT NULL, attributes.kibana.saved_object.type, attributes.event.action LIKE "ml_*ad_job", "ml-job", attributes.event.action LIKE "ml_*ad_datafeed", "ml-datafeed", attributes.event.action LIKE "workflow_execution_*", "workflow-execution", attributes.event.action LIKE "workflow_*", "workflow", attributes.event.action LIKE "agent_builder_agent_*", "agent-builder-agent", attributes.event.action LIKE "agent_builder_tool_*", "agent-builder-tool", attributes.event.action LIKE "product_documentation_*", "product-documentation", attributes.event.action == "secret_create", "secret", attributes.event.action IS NULL, "unclassified", REPLACE(attributes.event.action, "_(create|update|delete|enable|disable|run|run_soon|test|cancel)$", "")) | WHERE obj_id IS NOT NULL | STATS `Object types` = COUNT_DISTINCT(obj_type)

config.description: Distinct identities that changed anything in Kibana in range, resolved the same way every other actor panel resolves them. Counting emails alone misses changes made by credentials that carry no email. Includes people who only enabled a rule, ran a workflow or created an ML job — none of which an action-name suffix test counts as a change.

data_source.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE (resource.attributes.service.name == "serverless-kibana" AND ((attributes.event.type IN ("change","creation","deletion") AND (attributes.event.action IS NULL OR NOT (attributes.event.action IN ("saved_object_open_point_in_time","saved_object_close_point_in_time")))) OR attributes.event.action IN ("rule_run_soon","secret_create"))) | EVAL actor = COALESCE(attributes.user.email, attributes.api_key.name, attributes.user.name, "<anonymous>"), actor_kind = CASE(attributes.user.email IS NOT NULL, "human", "service") | STATS `Editors` = COUNT_DISTINCT(actor)

config.title: ⚠️ Mutations — the 30 most recent Kibana state changes
config.description: The single most important panel in the suite: state changes in Kibana, with who did it, what it was called, and which space it lives in. This is the 30 most recent — for a complete export use the Discover session below it. Two columns to read carefully. `type` and `name` are the real saved-object fields where Kibana records them and are otherwise recovered from the event message, because workflows, ML jobs and agent-builder objects carry no saved_object fields and would otherwise render as blank rows. `result` is "attempted" where Kibana logged the attempt rather than the outcome — that is how the saved-object path records things, so it is normal, and a "failure" here is a change that was denied.

data_source.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE (resource.attributes.service.name == "serverless-kibana" AND ((attributes.event.type IN ("change","creation","deletion") AND (attributes.event.action IS NULL OR NOT (attributes.event.action IN ("saved_object_open_point_in_time","saved_object_close_point_in_time")))) OR attributes.event.action IN ("rule_run_soon","secret_create"))) | EVAL verb = CASE(attributes.event.action LIKE "*_execution_cancel", "cancel", attributes.event.action LIKE "*_run_soon", "run", attributes.event.action LIKE "*_run", "run", attributes.event.action LIKE "*_test", "test", attributes.event.action LIKE "*_enable", "enable", attributes.event.action LIKE "*_disable", "disable", attributes.event.action LIKE "ml_put_*", "create", attributes.event.action LIKE "ml_open_*", "open", attributes.event.action LIKE "ml_start_*", "start", attributes.event.action LIKE "*point_in_time", "pit", attributes.event.action LIKE "*_create*", "create", attributes.event.action LIKE "*_update*", "update", attributes.event.action LIKE "*_delete", "delete", attributes.event.action LIKE "*_find", "find", attributes.event.action LIKE "*_get", "get", attributes.event.action LIKE "*_resolve", "resolve", "other") | GROK body.text """\[(?:id|workflowId)=%{DATA:g_id}(?:,|\])""" | GROK body.text """\[name=%{GREEDYDATA:g_name}\]""" | GROK body.text """\[executionId=%{DATA:g_exec}\]""" | GROK body.text """case id: %{NOTSPACE:g_case}""" | GROK body.text """(?:job|datafeed) %{NOTSPACE:g_ml}""" | EVAL obj_type = CASE(attributes.kibana.saved_object.type IS NOT NULL, attributes.kibana.saved_object.type, attributes.event.action LIKE "ml_*ad_job", "ml-job", attributes.event.action LIKE "ml_*ad_datafeed", "ml-datafeed", attributes.event.action LIKE "workflow_execution_*", "workflow-execution", attributes.event.action LIKE "workflow_*", "workflow", attributes.event.action LIKE "agent_builder_agent_*", "agent-builder-agent", attributes.event.action LIKE "agent_builder_tool_*", "agent-builder-tool", attributes.event.action LIKE "product_documentation_*", "product-documentation", attributes.event.action == "secret_create", "secret", attributes.event.action IS NULL, "unclassified", REPLACE(attributes.event.action, "_(create|update|delete|enable|disable|run|run_soon|test|cancel)$", "")) | EVAL obj_name = COALESCE(attributes.kibana.saved_object.name, g_name, g_id, attributes.kibana.saved_object.id, g_case, g_ml, g_exec, body.text) | EVAL result = CASE(attributes.event.outcome == "unknown", "attempted", attributes.event.outcome) | EVAL execution = COALESCE(LEFT(g_exec, 8), "—") | EVAL actor = COALESCE(attributes.user.email, attributes.api_key.name, attributes.user.name, "<anonymous>"), actor_kind = CASE(attributes.user.email IS NOT NULL, "human", "service") | STATS events = COUNT(*), last_change = MAX(@timestamp) BY actor, verb, type = obj_type, name = obj_name, space = attributes.kibana.space.id, result | SORT last_change DESC | LIMIT 30

config.title: Object type × operation
config.description: Heatmap of saved-object type against operation. Reads typically dominate; the create/update/delete columns are the forensic signal.

config.title: Saved-object activity over time
config.description: Saved-object operations over time, split by verb.

data_source.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE attributes.kibana.saved_object.type IS NOT NULL | EVAL verb = CASE(attributes.event.action LIKE "*_execution_cancel", "cancel", attributes.event.action LIKE "*_run_soon", "run", attributes.event.action LIKE "*_run", "run", attributes.event.action LIKE "*_test", "test", attributes.event.action LIKE "*_enable", "enable", attributes.event.action LIKE "*_disable", "disable", attributes.event.action LIKE "ml_put_*", "create", attributes.event.action LIKE "ml_open_*", "open", attributes.event.action LIKE "ml_start_*", "start", attributes.event.action LIKE "*point_in_time", "pit", attributes.event.action LIKE "*_create*", "create", attributes.event.action LIKE "*_update*", "update", attributes.event.action LIKE "*_delete", "delete", attributes.event.action LIKE "*_find", "find", attributes.event.action LIKE "*_get", "get", attributes.event.action LIKE "*_resolve", "resolve", "other") | STATS events = COUNT(*) BY BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend), verb

config.title: Most-accessed objects by name
config.description: Real object titles from kibana.saved_object.name — the dashboards, rules and other objects people actually opened.

data_source.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE attributes.kibana.saved_object.name IS NOT NULL | STATS events = COUNT(*), actors = COUNT_DISTINCT(attributes.user.email) BY name = attributes.kibana.saved_object.name, type = attributes.kibana.saved_object.type | SORT events DESC | LIMIT 15

config.title: Object types accessed
config.description: Share of saved-object traffic by type. Background reads by Kibana features and integrations can outweigh human activity.

data_source.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE attributes.kibana.saved_object.type IS NOT NULL | STATS events = COUNT(*) BY type = attributes.kibana.saved_object.type

FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE attributes.kibana.space.id IS NOT NULL | STATS events = COUNT(*) BY space = attributes.kibana.space.id

config.description: Audit trail for the high-value object types only — who touched which dashboard, SLO, rule, workflow or ML job, and when. The allow-list carries both `alert` and `alerting_rule`: Kibana records the same rule under either type depending on which code path audited it.

data_source.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE resource.attributes.service.name == "serverless-kibana" | EVAL verb = CASE(attributes.event.action LIKE "*_execution_cancel", "cancel", attributes.event.action LIKE "*_run_soon", "run", attributes.event.action LIKE "*_run", "run", attributes.event.action LIKE "*_test", "test", attributes.event.action LIKE "*_enable", "enable", attributes.event.action LIKE "*_disable", "disable", attributes.event.action LIKE "ml_put_*", "create", attributes.event.action LIKE "ml_open_*", "open", attributes.event.action LIKE "ml_start_*", "start", attributes.event.action LIKE "*point_in_time", "pit", attributes.event.action LIKE "*_create*", "create", attributes.event.action LIKE "*_update*", "update", attributes.event.action LIKE "*_delete", "delete", attributes.event.action LIKE "*_find", "find", attributes.event.action LIKE "*_get", "get", attributes.event.action LIKE "*_resolve", "resolve", "other") | GROK body.text """\[(?:id|workflowId)=%{DATA:g_id}(?:,|\])""" | GROK body.text """\[name=%{GREEDYDATA:g_name}\]""" | GROK body.text """\[executionId=%{DATA:g_exec}\]""" | GROK body.text """case id: %{NOTSPACE:g_case}""" | GROK body.text """(?:job|datafeed) %{NOTSPACE:g_ml}""" | EVAL obj_type = CASE(attributes.kibana.saved_object.type IS NOT NULL, attributes.kibana.saved_object.type, attributes.event.action LIKE "ml_*ad_job", "ml-job", attributes.event.action LIKE "ml_*ad_datafeed", "ml-datafeed", attributes.event.action LIKE "workflow_execution_*", "workflow-execution", attributes.event.action LIKE "workflow_*", "workflow", attributes.event.action LIKE "agent_builder_agent_*", "agent-builder-agent", attributes.event.action LIKE "agent_builder_tool_*", "agent-builder-tool", attributes.event.action LIKE "product_documentation_*", "product-documentation", attributes.event.action == "secret_create", "secret", attributes.event.action IS NULL, "unclassified", REPLACE(attributes.event.action, "_(create|update|delete|enable|disable|run|run_soon|test|cancel)$", "")) | EVAL obj_name = COALESCE(attributes.kibana.saved_object.name, g_name, g_id, attributes.kibana.saved_object.id, g_case, g_ml, g_exec, body.text) | WHERE obj_type IN ("dashboard","slo","alert","alerting_rule","tag","index-pattern","workflow","agent-builder-agent","agent-builder-tool","ml-job") | EVAL actor = COALESCE(attributes.user.email, attributes.api_key.name, attributes.user.name, "<anonymous>"), actor_kind = CASE(attributes.user.email IS NOT NULL, "human", "service") | STATS events = COUNT(*), last_seen = MAX(@timestamp) BY actor, verb, type = obj_type, name = obj_name | SORT last_seen DESC | LIMIT 15

config.title: Session reconstruction
config.description: One human’s Kibana session replayed in order — every object they opened and changed, with body.text rendering each event as a readable sentence. Pin an identity first and this becomes their hour, step by step.

config.title: Cross-space activity
config.description: Identities ranked by how many Kibana spaces they touched. Anything above one space is worth understanding.

config.title: Kibana saved-object activity
config.description: Full Kibana saved-object audit trail. body.text renders each event as a readable sentence.
